name: U.S. Department of State - Student Visa
verificationAdvice: Use the Department of State site and the official embassy/consulate or visa appointment portal for visa instructions. Do not trust payment requests sent only by chat or SMS.
notes: Conservative official URL for F/M student visa information.

name: Government of Canada - Study permit
verificationAdvice: Verify study permit steps in the official Government of Canada account or Canada.ca pages. Be suspicious of penalty-fee links in SMS or messaging apps.
notes: Institutions should add country-specific visa application center guidance during pilots.

name: GOV.UK - Student visa
verificationAdvice: Use GOV.UK and your university's official CAS/admissions instructions. Do not pay CAS release fees to personal or regional accounts.
notes: Universities should provide their own CAS verification contacts in pilots.

name: Australian Department of Home Affairs - Student visa subclass 500
verificationAdvice: Use ImmiAccount and Home Affairs pages for visa steps. Do not follow visa-payment instructions from social media or chat accounts.
notes: Education providers should add official international office contacts.

name: IELTS official
verificationAdvice: Register and verify test centers through IELTS official channels. Ignore private score-upgrade offers.
notes: Local IELTS partners vary by country; pilots can add approved local test-center pages.

name: ETS TOEFL official
verificationAdvice: Use ETS account pages for TOEFL registration and score services. Scores cannot be upgraded by private messaging contacts.
notes: Use regional ETS guidance where applicable during pilots.

name: College Board SAT official
verificationAdvice: Use College Board accounts and SAT Suite pages for registration and scores. Do not share logins or pay for score correction offers.
notes: Schools can add local SAT administration contacts.

name: EducationUSA
verificationAdvice: Use EducationUSA advising centers for U.S. study guidance and to sanity-check scholarship or agent claims.
notes: Official U.S. Department of State network for U.S. higher education advising.

name: Replace with official university admissions office
verificationAdvice: During a pilot, replace this template with the participating institution's official admissions page, payment portal, housing page, and published contact details.
notes: Template entry using a real university domain as an example of the type of official URL to provide; not a production endorsement or pilot partner.

name: Replace with school counselor or international office safety page
verificationAdvice: Replace this during implementation with the school's official student safety, counselor, or international office page and escalation contact.
notes: Template entry for pilots; institutions should supply their own official web page before launch.
